name: Sableis Sableis
keeps: the route, which is not written down
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Accused of raising the storm that struck James VI’s ship.
text: Sableis sableis of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 12th tranche, doors 105 to 114. Keeps the route, which is not written down. Reads John Fian.
